notes: Callaway 1969, IEJ 19 p. 239 (Kh. Haiyan paragraph) mentions a 5th-century monastery complex: church, residential area, stable and a wine press. No pool, pit (cistern) or grave is mentioned. The 'weli' over the church apse is not called a tomb by the publication, so it is not coded as a grave (it would in any case post-date the Byzantine church). The Ai reservoir on pp. 238-239 belongs to Ai, not this site. No plan. No absence statement for any feature class.
